sections.title: Move & resize
sections.help: Positions, sizes and looks of anything in the game.

sections.title: Stop sizes
sections.help: What a stop pays and how much it refills your tank, by the size of the place. Smaller places pay more because they're harder to name.

fields.label: Name shown in the game
fields.refill: Share of the tank refilled: 1 = full, 0.5 = half
fields.minPop: Population needed to count as this size (capitals are picked by status, not size)
fields.note: Size shown in the rules table
fields.rank: Order from biggest (0) to smallest; also sets the pitch of the stop chime

sections.title: Repeat visits
sections.help: Points multiplier for going back to a place you've stopped at before. The first number is a first visit, the second is a 2nd visit, and so on. The last number applies to every visit after that.

sections.title: Short hops
sections.help: A hop much shorter than your tank scores less, so ten villages 5 km apart don't beat one real leg.

fields.min: The lowest a short hop can score (0.25 = a quarter of the points)
fields.fullAt: A hop this share of the tank or longer scores in full (0.2 = a fifth of the tank)

sections.title: Checkpoint bonus
sections.help: Points for passing a checkpoint you picked when planning the trip.

sections.title: Hints and help
sections.help: What the in-trip tools cost, in points.

fields.ticketBonus: Points for arriving with an unused ferry ticket
fields.scoutCost: Scout ahead: shows places within reach
fields.revealCost: Reveal the name of a scouted place
fields.helpCost: Roadside help: refuel when you're stranded

sections.title: Flight prices
sections.help: A flight costs (base + km × per km) points, multiplied by growth for every flight already taken this trip. With the defaults, a 1,000 km flight costs 55, then 83, then 124.

fields.base: Fixed part of every flight's price
fields.growth: Each further flight on a trip costs this many times more

sections.title: Trip lengths
sections.help: The trip lengths players pick from. The start and destination are chosen this far apart.

fields.minPop: Start and destination must have at least this many people

sections.title: Trip length by vehicle
sections.help: Trip distances are multiplied by this for each vehicle. A bike trip is shorter than a car trip of the same length.

sections.title: Vehicles
sections.help: Range and behaviour of each vehicle. If you change a tank size, the Studio updates the number in the description for you.

fields.road: Longest strait it can cross by road (km)
fields.coastal: Can only stop at coastal places
fields.land: How far inland a boat can stop (km)
fields.rail: Travels only along real railway lines

sections.title: Difficulty rules
sections.help: The rule choices when setting up a trip. Harder choices multiply everything the trip scores (mult). Sliders: offMult applies when the slider is at zero, maxMult at its top.

fields.maxMult: Score multiplier at the slider's top

sections.title: Default rules
sections.help: The rules a new player starts with. Words must match an option id in Difficulty rules (e.g. planes: all, large or capitals).

sections.title: Weekly trip rules
sections.help: Fixed rules for the weekly challenge trip.

sections.title: High stakes
sections.help: The wager mode: bet coins on naming places under a clock.

sections.title: Map styles
sections.help: Map looks sold in the shop. The look itself is drawn in code, so you can rename and reprice these but not add new ones here.

sections.title: Vehicle markers
sections.help: Emoji markers that replace a vehicle's icon on the map.

fields.vehicle: Which vehicle it's for: car, bike, boat or train

sections.title: Route colours
sections.help: Colours for your route line.

sections.title: Cursors
sections.help: Mouse cursors. Leave the emoji empty for the normal pointer.

sections.title: Supplies
sections.help: One-off items used during a trip. What each one does is in code; you can change names, prices and descriptions. The ferry-ticket price is also what a stranded player pays at the port.

sections.title: Upgrades
sections.help: Permanent upgrades. League is the passport league needed to buy one (0 = anyone; see Passport leagues). Their effects are in code, so if you change a description, check it still matches.

fields.league: Passport league needed (0 = Travel document, 1 = Passport, 2 = Service, 3 = Diplomatic, 4 = Laissez-passer)

sections.title: Destination signs
sections.help: Looks for the destination sign. The looks are drawn in code.

sections.title: Route trails
sections.help: Line styles for the route. The styles are drawn in code.

sections.title: Arrival effects
sections.help: What happens on the map when you arrive.

sections.title: Stamp inks
sections.help: Ink colours for passport stamps. Click a swatch to change it.

sections.title: Sound packs
sections.help: The chime played when you score. type is the wave shape (sine, triangle, square or sawtooth), base the first note's pitch in Hz, gap the time between notes and decay how long each note rings (seconds).

sections.title: Holo shine
sections.help: The shimmer upgrade for legendary flags.

sections.title: Interface themes
sections.help: Colour themes for the whole interface, each with a day and a night palette. Open a theme's day or night to change its colours.

sections.title: Emoji styles
sections.help: Emoji themes: the game's emoji drawn in one Icons8 icon style. The key is the Icons8 style; its art comes from assets/icons8/themes on the owner's Mac (tools/icons8-themes.py), so a new style needs art there first. Standard is the device's own emoji and stays free.

sections.title: Study decks
sections.help: Flashcard decks in the Study tab. Which places are in each deck is set in code.

sections.title: Garage models
sections.help: Drawn vehicle models in the garage. The drawings are in code.

sections.title: Exhaust trails
sections.help: Particles left behind a moving vehicle. The effects are in code.

sections.title: Passport cover finishes
sections.help: Finishes drawn over the passport cover. The artwork is in code.

sections.title: Mottos
sections.help: Lines players can buy to show under their name. Add as many as you like; give each a unique id.

sections.title: Country mastery
sections.help: How well a player knows a country, by knowledge points (at). Colours tint the mastery map.

sections.title: Flag rarity
sections.help: Flag rarities and the coins each one pays when collected.

sections.title: Collector ranks
sections.help: Titles for the size of a flag collection.

sections.title: Album milestones
sections.help: Shares of an album (0.25 = a quarter) that pay a reward. Pairs with Album rewards.

sections.title: Album rewards
sections.help: Multiplier for each album milestone's coins. A milestone pays (15 + 2 × flags in the album) × this. Small albums (under 8 flags) have one milestone at 100%.

sections.title: Flag rating cap
sections.help: The most the flag collection adds to the explorer rating.

sections.title: Wanted-flag bonus
sections.help: Extra coins for each flag on the daily wanted board, on top of three times its usual coins.

sections.title: Sweep bonus
sections.help: Coins for collecting all three flags on the daily wanted board.

sections.title: Passport leagues
sections.help: Leagues by explorer rating (at). The emblem must be doc, globe or laurel.

sections.title: Trip par scores
sections.help: A good score for each trip length. The explorer rating compares recent trips against these.

sections.title: Par by vehicle
sections.help: Par is multiplied by this for each vehicle, since a bike trip scores less than a car trip.

sections.title: Country covers unlock
sections.help: Stops in a country needed to unlock its passport cover.

sections.title: Streaks and boosts
sections.help: Daily-streak rewards and the holo-flag chances.

fields.streakMilestones: Streak day and the coins it pays
fields.boostDays: Days away from the game that earn a boosted first trip back
fields.holoNew: Chance a new flag is holo (0.05 = 5%)
fields.holoAgain: Chance a repeat flag is holo
fields.holoPay: Holo flags pay this many times the coins

sections.title: Races and bounties
sections.help: Choices for online races and bounties. The server checks these too; they go live together when you publish.
